result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street lined with row houses and mature street trees. While continuous sidewalks and on-street parking provide some protection, the environment lacks formal crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the narrow street limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians who might attempt to cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs where cars are parked.

hazards.name: Lack of designated crossing points
hazards.description: In a long residential block, the absence of marked crossings or curb extensions increases the risk for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible length of the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures like speed humps to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with row houses and a continuous concrete sidewalk. While the walkway is wide and unobstructed, it lacks a buffer from the roadway and visibility is partially blocked by a large parked vehicle.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pickup truck parked at the curb significantly blocks sightlines between the sidewalk and the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground, parked along the curb

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: Cracks and minor surface degradation on the concrete sidewalk create potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sections of the concrete walkway to ensure a smooth and accessible surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or additional street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

result.summary: A narrow residential street with row houses and parallel parking on both sides. The pedestrian environment is constrained by very narrow sidewalks that are obstructed by parked vehicles and utility markers, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large parked vehicles and utility markers block the narrow walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the travel lane.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large parked trucks block sightlines between pedestrians and any approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven sidewalk surfaces present a tripping hazard.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Reallocate street space to widen the sidewalks, ensuring a clear, unobstructed path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections and potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and prevent vehicles from parking on or blocking the sidewalk area.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street corner with row houses and continuous sidewalks on both sides. While the environment appears to be a low-speed residential area, it lacks essential safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and daylighting at the intersection.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near intersection
hazards.description: Vehicles parked right up to the corner obstruct sightlines between pedestrians attempting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street at the intersection corner

hazards.name: Absence of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: The lack of designated crossing markings reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian activity at the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility ladder or zebra crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the corner.
